column3: Legacy v1 correctly rejects Dhrystone lane1-to-lane0 because its bound phase-alignment qualifier remains normative; A1/A2 original FAIL receipts stay immutable.

V2 qualification uses the exact two-lane endpoint equation under a bound normative erratum and preserves every v4 identity, conservation, availability, overflow, invalid-event and unknown-ratio check.
Downstream PERF_BASELINE methodology lives under eval/ppa, not design/arch, so publishing a performance receipt cannot mutate the upstream ARCH_STABLE specification inventory.

Composite replay reuses complete frozen A2 execution because production RTL, elaborated design, simulator, configuration, workload images and device semantics did not change; fresh DUT execution was not required.
